study type: historical before and after control study
cohort: Expectant mothers registered in the outpatient department of a grade III, level A hospital, divided into an observation group receiving prenatal cluster management and a control group receiving traditional routine prenatal management.
finding: Antenatal cluster care significantly improved maternal and neonatal outcomes, including higher natural delivery rates, better neonatal prognosis, increased exclusive breastfeeding, and reduced postpartum complications and hospital stays, alongside improved postpartum health and satisfaction.
mod_finding: The observation group, which received antenatal cluster management, had a significantly higher natural delivery rate compared to the control group.
